title: Minocycline mitigates Abeta and TAU pathology, neuronal dysfunction, and death in the PSEN1 E280A cholinergic-like neurons model of familial Alzheimer's disease.
authors: Giraldo-Berrio, Daniela; Jimenez-Del-Rio, Marlene; Velez-Pardo, Carlos
one_liner_zh: 该文研究米诺环素对家族性阿尔茨海默病胆碱能神经元模型的保护作用，仅含分子对接预测小分子与Abeta/TAU/caspase 3结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Familial Alzheimer's disease (FAD) presenilin 1 E280A (PSEN1 E280A) is a severe neurological condition due to the loss of cholinergic neurons (ChNs), accumulation of amyloid beta (Abeta), and abnormal phosphorylation of the TAU protein. Up to date, there are no effective therapies available. The need for innovative treatments for this illness is critical. We found that minocycline (MC, 5 muM) was innocuous toward wild-type (WT) PSEN1 ChLNs but significantly (i) reduces the accumulation of intracellular Abeta by -69%, (ii) blocks both abnormal phosphorylation of the protein TAU at residue Ser202/Thr205 by -33% and (iii) phosphorylation of the proapoptotic transcription factor c-JUN at residue Ser63/Ser73 by -25%, (iv) diminishes oxidized DJ-1 at Cys106-SO(3) by -29%, (v) downregulates the expression of transcription factor TP53, (vi) BH-3-only protein PUMA, and (vii) cleaved caspase 3 (CC3) by -33, -86, and -78%, respectively, compared with untreated PSEN1 E280A ChLNs. Additionally, MC increases the response to ACh-induced Ca(2+) influx by +92% in mutant ChLNs. Oxygen radical absorbance capacity (ORAC) and ferric ion-reducing antioxidant power (FRAP) analysis showed that MC might operate more efficiently as a hydrogen atom transfer agent than a single electron transfer agent. In silico molecular docking analysis predicts that MC binds with high affinity to Abeta (Vina Score -6.6 kcal/mol), TAU (VS -6.5 kcal/mol), and caspase 3 (VS -7.1 kcal/mol). Taken together, our findings suggest that MC demonstrates antioxidant, anti-amyloid, and anti-apoptosis activity and promotes physiological ACh-induced Ca(2+) influx in PSEN1 E280A ChLNs. The MC has therapeutic potential for treating early-onset FAD.
abstract_zh: 家族性阿尔茨海默病（FAD）早老素1 E280A（PSEN1 E280A）是一种严重的神经系统疾病，其病因包括胆碱能神经元（ChNs）的丧失、淀粉样β蛋白（Abeta）的积累以及TAU蛋白的异常磷酸化。迄今为止，尚无有效疗法。对此疾病创新治疗的需求至关重要。我们发现，米诺环素（MC，5 μM）对野生型（WT）PSEN1 ChLNs无害，但显著地（i）将细胞内Abeta积累减少约69%，（ii）阻断TAU蛋白在Ser202/Thr205残基处的异常磷酸化约33%，（iii）抑制促凋亡转录因子c-JUN在Ser63/Ser73残基处的磷酸化约25%，（iv）减少氧化型DJ-1在Cys106-SO(3)处的水平约29%，（v）下调转录因子TP53的表达，（vi）下调BH-3-only蛋白PUMA的表达，以及（vii）分别将裂解型caspase 3（CC3）减少33%、86%和78%，与未处理的PSEN1 E280A ChLNs相比。此外，MC在突变型ChLNs中将ACh诱导的Ca(2+)内流反应增加92%。氧自由基吸收能力（ORAC）和三价铁离子还原抗氧化能力（FRAP）分析表明，MC可能更有效地作为氢原子转移剂而非单电子转移剂发挥作用。计算机分子对接分析预测，MC与Abeta（Vina Score -6.6 kcal/mol）、TAU（VS -6.5 kcal/mol）和caspase 3（VS -7.1 kcal/mol）具有高亲和力结合。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，MC在PSEN1 E280A ChLNs中表现出抗氧化、抗淀粉样蛋白和抗凋亡活性，并促进生理性ACh诱导的Ca(2+)内流。MC具有治疗早发性FAD的潜力。
